candidates.name: Architecture A (kinetics+cooling)
candidates.role: smaller particles cut solid-diffusion overpotential (anti-plating), higher cooling h reduces T_max

candidates.name: Architecture B (transport+cooling)
candidates.role: high-transport electrolyte formulation reduces electrolyte polarization (anti-plating) and ohmic heat

candidates.name: Architecture C (combined)
candidates.role: kinetics + transport + liquid cooling, strongest anti-plating/thermal combination

llm_reason: Baseline 4C fails plating (anode_potential_v min ~ -0.19V) and T_max (354.3K > 333.15K). Cause lives at cell scale (Stage 3): solid-diffusion and electrolyte-transport polarization plus limited cooling. Mass-neutral levers (particle size, electrolyte transport, cooling h) target both without sacrificing the 400.75 Wh/kg ED margin. Electrolyte values are formulation estimates (high-transport electrolyte, marked estimate).
